title: feat(spec)!: RealtimeEventType names the emitted data.record.* / data.records.* vocabulary (#20288)
body:
Closes #20288

Clause-②: yes (narrowing)

`RealtimeEventType` (`@objectstack/spec/api`, the type of `SubscriptionEvent.type`) now names exactly what the runtime emits: `DataEventType` + `BulkDataEventType`, i.e. `data.record.created` / `data.record.updated` / `data.record.deleted` and `data.records.updated` / `data.records.deleted`. Its four old values (`record.created`, `record.updated`, `record.deleted`, `field.changed`), which nothing ever emitted, are refused with a per-value prescription. The runtime's published event names do not change.

- Schema and pins: `packages/spec/src/api/realtime.zod.ts`, `realtime.test.ts` (the enum equals `DataEventType` + `BulkDataEventType`; each retired value is refused through `SubscriptionSchema` with its code, path and first sentence pinned).
- ADR-0087: D3 semantic entry `realtime-event-type-unemitted-values-retired`. No D2 conversion, because a subscription is never a stack collection member or a stored row.
- Stale examples: the `service-realtime` README and `InMemoryRealtimeAdapter` docblock, and the `RealtimeEventPayload.type` / `RealtimeEvent.type` examples. The `realtime` reference page is regenerated.
- Ledger: a one-line `_note` pointer in `liveness/realtime_subscription.json` (#14646 ruling A, #8347 ruling 甲).
- Changesets: `@objectstack/spec` minor (BREAKING, FROM → TO), `@objectstack/service-realtime` patch.

No transport, no route and no client subscribe primitive (#14646 ruling A). The verification evidence is in the dev report on the card.
